vs_storybook.storybook: 당신과 별의 감정 — close / emotional / 클로즈업
vs_storybook.miracle: 당신의 별이 살아가는 세계 — wide / environmental / 와이드샷

visual_grammar.style: 2D watercolor, Korean animation style, Ghibli emotional tone
visual_grammar.lighting: moonlight, harbor glow, soft water reflection
visual_grammar.composition: wide cinematic watercolor frame, harbor visible, sky breathing
visual_grammar.character: small silhouette only, emotional trace remains — NOT the focal point

base_prompt: A dreamy watercolor night view of Yeosu harbor, soft glowing stars above the sea, wide environmental composition, small girl silhouette quietly watching the sky, Korean emotional animation style, 2D watercolor texture, soft harbor lights reflecting on water, gentle magical atmosphere, calm cinematic framing, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, hyper detailed, close-up face, large character, person as focal point, mascot character, cartoon exaggeration, commercial travel poster, tourism advertisement, cinematic lens flare, excessive particle FX, text, letters, numbers, watermark, signature, logo, multiple people, busy composition, harsh lighting, dark horror, gloomy, oppressive

future_expansion.note: 현재 MVP에서는 구현 금지. 구조만 확보.

yeosu_harbor.label: 여수 항구 파노라마
yeosu_harbor.scene_description: Yeosu harbor night panorama, wide open sky above calm dark sea, distant city lights softly reflected, harbor silhouette and boats in the distance
yeosu_harbor.character_instruction: tiny girl silhouette standing at harbor edge, facing the sea, occupies bottom 8% of frame, centered
yeosu_harbor.atmosphere: calm harbor silence, moonlight on water, soft star glow above the sea horizon
yeosu_harbor.must_remain: wide open space dominates — sky and sea are the world, person is a whisper

yeosu_cablecar_night.label: 케이블카 야경
yeosu_cablecar_night.scene_description: Yeosu cable car skyline at night, aerial view showing the city lights below and stars above, cable wires extending across the dark sky
yeosu_cablecar_night.character_instruction: barely visible tiny silhouette near cable car station, occupies bottom 5% of frame, slightly off-center
yeosu_cablecar_night.atmosphere: floating above the city lights, dreamlike suspension between earth and sky, stars feel reachable
yeosu_cablecar_night.must_remain: the world viewed from above — vastness of night sky and harbor city is the protagonist

yeosu_dolsan.label: 돌산 야경
yeosu_dolsan.scene_description: Dolsan bridge night lights reflecting on Yeosu sea, wide panoramic view of the illuminated bridge arching over dark calm water, city lights in the background
yeosu_dolsan.character_instruction: small girl silhouette on bridge walkway or nearby shore, occupies bottom 10% of frame, centered
yeosu_dolsan.atmosphere: bridge lights create a soft golden path on water, quiet miracle feeling — the world built for this moment
yeosu_dolsan.must_remain: bridge and sea are the world — the person witnesses, not performs
